project.snapshot() #1
GetUserInputs("Apply Arrangement", 1, "Arrangement name (Ghost / Packed / Shrink / Swapped / Tiny):,extrawidth=200", "") -> true, "Shrink"
ShowMessageBox("Apply Arrangement", 3) -> 6 <<
Apply Headroom to 1 region?

  B: -8.0 s

Each Apply moves these region ends again.

Yes - apply with Headroom
No - apply without Headroom
Cancel - do nothing
>>
ShowMessageBox("Apply Arrangement", 0) -> 1 <<
"B" can't shrink by 8.0 s. The most it can lose without cutting into its content is 6.0 s. Lower its Headroom on the Arrange page's Edit tab, then try again.
>>
